<!-- ── JAVASCRIPT ──────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<script>
  /* ── Utility ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const $ = (s, ctx = document) => ctx.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, ctx = document) => [...ctx.querySelectorAll(s)];

  /* ── Team Data ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const TEAM = {
    na: [
      {
        name: 'Denice Alvarez',
        title: 'Office Manager',
        office: 'New York',
        quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580489944761-15a19d654956?w=500&q=80'
      },
      {
        name: 'Marco Bellini',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'San Francisco',
        quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ],
    asia: [
      {
        name: 'Priya Mehta',
        title: 'Studio Head',
        office: 'Bangalore',
        quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108755-2616b612b786?w=500&q=80'
      },
      {
        name: 'Thierry Lam',
        title: 'Design Lead',
        office: 'Singapore',
        quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ],
    europe: [
      {
        name: 'Gavin Hartley',
        title: 'Managing Director',
        office: 'London',
        quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results.",
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560250097-0b93528c311a?w=500&q=80'
      },
      {
        name: 'Francesca Terzi',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'Munich',
        quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1573496359142-b8d87734a5a2?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ],
    oceania: [
      {
        name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho',
        title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation',
        office: 'Melbourne',
        quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1598550874175-4d0ef436c909?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ]
  };

  /* ── Hero Carousel ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const track = $('#heroTrack');
    const dots  = $$('.hero-dot');
    const progress = $('#heroProgress');
    let current = 0;
    const total = 5;
    let timer, startTime, raf;
    const INTERVAL = 6000;

    function goTo(idx) {
      current = (idx + total) % total;
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${current * 100}%)`;
      dots.forEach((d, i) => {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === current);
        d.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === current ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      resetProgress();
    }

    function resetProgress() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      clearTimeout(timer);
      startTime = performance.now();
      animateProgress();
      timer = setTimeout(() => goTo(current + 1), INTERVAL);
    }

    function animateProgress() {
      const elapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
      const pct = Math.min((elapsed / INTERVAL) * 100, 100);
      progress.style.width = pct + '%';
      if (pct < 100) raf = requestAnimationFrame(animateProgress);
    }

    $('#heroPrev').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current - 1));
    $('#heroNext').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current + 1));

    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i)));

    // Touch/swipe
    let tx = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend',   e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 50) goTo(current + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
    }, {passive:true});

    goTo(0);
  })();

  /* ── Team Carousel ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const track     = $('#teamTrack');
    const tabs      = $$('.region-tab');
    const prevBtn   = $('#teamPrev');
    const nextBtn   = $('#teamNext');
    let currentRegion = 'na';
    let offset = 0;
    const CARD_W = 320 + 24; // card width + gap

    function renderCards(region) {
      track.innerHTML = '';
      offset = 0;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      TEAM[region].forEach(m => {
        const card = document.createElement('article');
        card.className = 'team-card';
        card.setAttribute('role', 'group');
        card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${m.name}, ${m.title}`);
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="team-card-photo">
            <img src="${m.img}" alt="${m.name}" loading="lazy" />
          </div>
          <div class="team-card-body">
            <p class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</p>
            <div class="team-card-name">${m.name}</div>
            <div class="team-card-title">${m.title}</div>
            <a href="#" class="team-card-cta">
              Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"/></svg>
            </a>
          </div>
        `;
        track.appendChild(card);
      });
      updateNavBtns(region);
    }

    function updateNavBtns(region) {
      const count = TEAM[region].length;
      const visible = Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / CARD_W) || 1;
      prevBtn.disabled = offset <= 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = offset >= (count - visible) * CARD_W;
    }

    function slide(dir) {
      const region = currentRegion;
      const count  = TEAM[region].length;
      const visible = Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / CARD_W) || 1;
      const max = Math.max(0, (count - visible) * CARD_W);
      offset = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset + dir * CARD_W, max));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;
      updateNavBtns(region);
    }

    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        tabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false'); });
        tab.classList.add('active');
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
        currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
        renderCards(currentRegion);
      });
    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => slide(-1));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => slide(1));

    // Swipe
    let tx = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend',   e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) slide(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});

    renderCards('na');
  })();

  /* ── Work Carousel ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const track   = $('#workTrack');
    const prevBtn = $('#workPrev');
    const nextBtn = $('#workNext');
    const countEl = $('#workCount');
    const CARD_W  = 380 + 24;
    const total   = 8;
    let offset = 0;

    function visible() {
      return Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / CARD_W) || 1;
    }
    function current() {
      return Math.round(offset / CARD_W) + 1;
    }

    function update() {
      const max = Math.max(0, (total - visible()) * CARD_W);
      offset = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset, max));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;
      prevBtn.disabled = offset <= 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = offset >= max;
      countEl.textContent = `${current()} / ${total}`;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { offset = Math.max(0, offset - CARD_W); update(); });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { offset += CARD_W; update(); });

    // Swipe
    let tx = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend',   e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) {
        offset += dx < 0 ? CARD_W : -CARD_W;
        update();
      }
    }, {passive:true});

    update();
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  })();

  /* ── Language Selector ────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const btn      = $('#langBtn');
    const dropdown = $('#langDropdown');

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const open = dropdown.classList.toggle('open');
      btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    dropdown.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropdown.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
        a.classList.add('active');
        btn.childNodes[2].textContent = ' ' + a.textContent.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ');
        dropdown.classList.remove('open');
        btn.classList.remove('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', () => {
      dropdown.classList.remove('open');
      btn.classList.remove('open');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    });
  })();

  /* ── Mobile Nav ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const btn  = $('#navHamburger');
    const menu = $('#navMobile');

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = menu.classList.toggle('open');
      btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', () => {
        menu.classList.remove('open');
        btn.classList.remove('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
    });
  })();

  /* ── Cookie Banner ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const banner   = $('#cookie-banner');
    const accept   = $('#cookieAccept');
    const decline  = $('#cookieDecline');
    const settings = $('#cookieSettingsBtn');

    function dismiss() {
      banner.classList.add('hidden');
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('cookieAcknowledged','1'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    if (sessionStorage.getItem('cookieAcknowledged')) {
      banner.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    accept.addEventListener('click',  dismiss);
    decline.addEventListener('click', dismiss);
    settings.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      banner.classList.toggle('hidden');
    });
  })();

  /* ── Scroll-aware nav ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const nav = $('#main-nav');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      nav.style.background = window.scrollY > 20
        ? 'rgba(10,10,10,0.95)'
        : 'rgba(10,10,10,0.85)';
    }, {passive:true});
  })();
</script>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    /* ─── Reset & Base ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --bg: #0A0A0A;
      --bg-surface: #111111;
      --bg-elevated: #1A1A1A;
      --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      --border-bright: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      --text-primary: #FFFFFF;
      --text-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      --text-muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      --accent: #3B82F6;
      --accent-glow: rgba(59,130,246,0.25);
      --amber: #F59E0B;
      --font: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
      --max-w: 1280px;
      --nav-h: 72px;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: var(--font); }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    /* ─── Utility ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--max-w);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 2rem;
    }
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px;
      padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
    }

    /* ─── NAV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #main-nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: var(--nav-h);
      background: rgba(10,10,10,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      z-index: 1000;
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }
    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 100%;
      gap: 2rem;
    }
    .nav-logo {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .nav-logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .nav-links .cta-link {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--accent);
      padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .nav-links .cta-link:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* Language selector */
    .lang-selector { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .lang-btn {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
      background: transparent;
    }
    .lang-btn:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .lang-btn svg { transition: transform 0.2s; }
    .lang-btn.open svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .lang-dropdown {
      position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-width: 140px;
      opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s;
      z-index: 200;
    }
    .lang-dropdown.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; transform: translateY(0); }
    .lang-dropdown a {
      display: block; padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .lang-dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .lang-dropdown a.active { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .nav-hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-hamburger span {
      display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile nav */
    .nav-mobile {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }
    .nav-mobile.open { display: flex; }
    .nav-mobile a {
      font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-mobile a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

    /* ─── HERO CAROUSEL ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #hero {
      margin-top: var(--nav-h);
      position: relative;
      height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-h));
      min-height: 560px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-track {
      display: flex;
      height: 100%;
      transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .hero-slide {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }
    .hero-slide-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-size: cover; background-position: center;
    }
    .hero-slide-bg::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        to top,
        rgba(10,10,10,0.92) 0%,
        rgba(10,10,10,0.55) 50%,
        rgba(10,10,10,0.2) 100%
      );
    }
    .hero-content {
      position: relative; z-index: 2;
      padding: 0 2rem 5rem;
      max-width: 720px;
    }
    .hero-tag {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .hero-tag::before {
      content: ''; display: block;
      width: 20px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--accent);
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.75rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .hero-body {
      font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      max-width: 540px;
    }
    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
      background: var(--text-primary); color: #000;
      font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.8rem 1.75rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .hero-cta:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .hero-cta svg { transition: transform 0.2s; }
    .hero-cta:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

    /* Hero controls */
    .hero-controls {
      position: absolute; bottom: 2.5rem; right: 2rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .hero-nav-btn {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .hero-nav-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

    .hero-dots {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      position: absolute; bottom: 2rem; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .hero-dot {
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .hero-dot.active {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      transform: scale(1.5);
    }

    /* Progress bar */
    .hero-progress {
      position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--accent);
      z-index: 10;
      transition: width 0.1s linear;
    }

    /* ─── SECTION COMMON ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    section { padding: 6rem 0; }
    .section-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .section-head { margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }

    /* ─── TEAM SECTION ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #team { background: var(--bg-surface); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

    .region-tabs {
      display: flex; gap: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }
    .region-tab {
      font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .region-tab:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); }
    .region-tab.active { color: var(--text-primary); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

    .team-carousel-wrapper { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .team-track {
      display: flex; gap: 1.5rem;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .team-card {
      min-width: 320px;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .team-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .team-card-photo {
      width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .team-card-photo img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(25%) brightness(0.85);
      transition: filter 0.3s, transform 0.4s;
    }
    .team-card:hover .team-card-photo img {
      filter: grayscale(0%) brightness(0.95);
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }
    .team-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; }
    .team-card-quote {
      font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .team-card-quote::before { content: '"'; }
    .team-card-quote::after { content: '"'; }
    .team-card-name {
      font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    }
    .team-card-title {
      font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .team-card-cta {
      font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .team-card-cta:hover { gap: 0.6rem; }

    .team-nav {
      display: flex; gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    .team-nav-btn {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .team-nav-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    .team-nav-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }

    /* ─── WORK SHOWCASE ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #work { overflow: hidden; }
    .work-scroll-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .work-track {
      display: flex; gap: 1.5rem;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .work-card {
      min-width: 380px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .work-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .work-card-thumb {
      width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-elevated);
    }
    .work-card-thumb img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: brightness(0.75) saturate(0.8);
      transition: filter 0.35s, transform 0.4s;
    }
    .work-card:hover .work-card-thumb img {
      filter: brightness(0.9) saturate(1);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }
    .work-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; }
    .work-card-client {
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .work-card-title {
      font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .work-card-quote {
      font-size: 0.825rem; line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .work-card-link {
      font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .work-card-link:hover { gap: 0.6rem; }

    .work-nav {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    .work-nav-btn {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .work-nav-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    .work-nav-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .work-count {
      font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* ─── CTA BANNER ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #cta-banner {
      background: var(--accent);
      padding: 5rem 0;
    }
    .cta-banner-inner {
      display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between; gap: 3rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .cta-banner-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .cta-banner-body {
      font-size: 1rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      max-width: 520px; line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .cta-banner-btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      background: #000; color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .cta-banner-btn:hover { background: #1a1a1a; transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* ─── HOW WE WORK ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #how-we-work {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .hww-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 5rem; align-items: center;
    }
    .hww-visual {
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .hww-visual img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: brightness(0.7) saturate(0.7);
    }
    .hww-text .section-title { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .hww-body {
      font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }
    .hww-cta {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
      padding-bottom: 2px;
      transition: color 0.2s, gap 0.2s;
    }
    .hww-cta:hover { color: var(--accent); gap: 0.9rem; }

    /* ─── LATEST INSIGHTS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    #insights { background: var(--bg-surface); }
    .insights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .insight-card {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .insight-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .insight-thumb {
      width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg);
    }
    .insight-thumb img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: brightness(0.7) saturate(0.6);
      transition: filter 0.35s, transform 0.4s;
    }
    .insight-card:hover .insight-thumb img {
      filter: brightness(0.85) saturate(0.85);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }
    .insight-body { padding: 1.25rem; }
    .insight-type {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .type-podcast { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color: #60A5FA; }
    .type-article { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color: #FCD34D; }
    .type-report  { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: #6EE7B7; }
    .insight-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .insight-link {
      font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .insight-link:hover { gap: 0.6rem; }

    /* ─── PRINCIPLES ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #principles { background: var(--bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .principles-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 3rem;
    }
    .principle-item {
      display: flex; gap: 1.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 3rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .principle-item:nth-last-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
    .principle-num {
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--accent);
      padding-top: 0.1rem;
      min-width: 28px;
    }
    .principle-title {
      font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .principle-body {
      font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* ─── FOOTER ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    footer {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 5rem 0 2.5rem;
    }
    .footer-ctas {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.5px; background: var(--border);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 4rem;
    }
    .footer-cta-block {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      padding: 3rem;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }
    .footer-cta-text {
      font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .footer-cta-btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--text-primary); color: #000;
      font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px;
      align-self: flex-start;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .footer-cta-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .footer-links {
      display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

<script>
  /* ── Utility ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const $ = (s, ctx = document) => ctx.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, ctx = document) => [...ctx.querySelectorAll(s)];

  /* ── Team Data ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const TEAM = {
    na: [
      {
        name: 'Denice Alvarez',
        title: 'Office Manager',
        office: 'New York',
        quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580489944761-15a19d654956?w=500&q=80'
      },
      {
        name: 'Marco Bellini',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'San Francisco',
        quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ],
    asia: [
      {
        name: 'Priya Mehta',
        title: 'Studio Head',
        office: 'Bangalore',
        quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108755-2616b612b786?w=500&q=80'
      },
      {
        name: 'Thierry Lam',
        title: 'Design Lead',
        office: 'Singapore',
        quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ],
    europe: [
      {
        name: 'Gavin Hartley',
        title: 'Managing Director',
        office: 'London',
        quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results.",
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560250097-0b93528c311a?w=500&q=80'
      },
      {
        name: 'Francesca Terzi',
        title: 'Design Director',
        office: 'Munich',
        quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1573496359142-b8d87734a5a2?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ],
    oceania: [
      {
        name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho',
        title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation',
        office: 'Melbourne',
        quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.',
        img: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1598550874175-4d0ef436c909?w=500&q=80'
      }
    ]
  };

  /* ── Hero Carousel ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const track = $('#heroTrack');
    const dots  = $$('.hero-dot');
    const progress = $('#heroProgress');
    let current = 0;
    const total = 5;
    let timer, startTime, raf;
    const INTERVAL = 6000;

    function goTo(idx) {
      current = (idx + total) % total;
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${current * 100}%)`;
      dots.forEach((d, i) => {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === current);
        d.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === current ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      resetProgress();
    }

    function resetProgress() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      clearTimeout(timer);
      startTime = performance.now();
      animateProgress();
      timer = setTimeout(() => goTo(current + 1), INTERVAL);
    }

    function animateProgress() {
      const elapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
      const pct = Math.min((elapsed / INTERVAL) * 100, 100);
      progress.style.width = pct + '%';
      if (pct < 100) raf = requestAnimationFrame(animateProgress);
    }

    $('#heroPrev').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current - 1));
    $('#heroNext').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current + 1));

    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i)));

    // Touch/swipe
    let tx = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend',   e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 50) goTo(current + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
    }, {passive:true});

    goTo(0);
  })();

  /* ── Team Carousel ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const track     = $('#teamTrack');
    const tabs      = $$('.region-tab');
    const prevBtn   = $('#teamPrev');
    const nextBtn   = $('#teamNext');
    let currentRegion = 'na';
    let offset = 0;
    const CARD_W = 320 + 24; // card width + gap

    function renderCards(region) {
      track.innerHTML = '';
      offset = 0;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      TEAM[region].forEach(m => {
        const card = document.createElement('article');
        card.className = 'team-card';
        card.setAttribute('role', 'group');
        card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${m.name}, ${m.title}`);
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="team-card-photo">
            <img src="${m.img}" alt="${m.name}" loading="lazy" />
          </div>
          <div class="team-card-body">
            <p class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</p>
            <div class="team-card-name">${m.name}</div>
            <div class="team-card-title">${m.title}</div>
            <a href="#" class="team-card-cta">
              Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"/></svg>
            </a>
          </div>
        `;
        track.appendChild(card);
      });
      updateNavBtns(region);
    }

    function updateNavBtns(region) {
      const count = TEAM[region].length;
      const visible = Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / CARD_W) || 1;
      prevBtn.disabled = offset <= 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = offset >= (count - visible) * CARD_W;
    }

    function slide(dir) {
      const region = currentRegion;
      const count  = TEAM[region].length;
      const visible = Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / CARD_W) || 1;
      const max = Math.max(0, (count - visible) * CARD_W);
      offset = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset + dir * CARD_W, max));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;
      updateNavBtns(region);
    }

    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        tabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false'); });
        tab.classList.add('active');
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
        currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
        renderCards(currentRegion);
      });
    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => slide(-1));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => slide(1));

    // Swipe
    let tx = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend',   e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) slide(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});

    renderCards('na');
  })();

  /* ── Work Carousel ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const track   = $('#workTrack');
    const prevBtn = $('#workPrev');
    const nextBtn = $('#workNext');
    const countEl = $('#workCount');
    const CARD_W  = 380 + 24;
    const total   = 8;
    let offset = 0;

    function visible() {
      return Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / CARD_W) || 1;
    }
    function current() {
      return Math.round(offset / CARD_W) + 1;
    }

    function update() {
      const max = Math.max(0, (total - visible()) * CARD_W);
      offset = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset, max));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;
      prevBtn.disabled = offset <= 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = offset >= max;
      countEl.textContent = `${current()} / ${total}`;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { offset = Math.max(0, offset - CARD_W); update(); });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { offset += CARD_W; update(); });

    // Swipe
    let tx = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend',   e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) {
        offset += dx < 0 ? CARD_W : -CARD_W;
        update();
      }
    }, {passive:true});

    update();
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  })();

  /* ── Language Selector ────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const btn      = $('#langBtn');
    const dropdown = $('#langDropdown');

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const open = dropdown.classList.toggle('open');
      btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    dropdown.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropdown.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
        a.classList.add('active');
        btn.childNodes[2].textContent = ' ' + a.textContent.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ');
        dropdown.classList.remove('open');
        btn.classList.remove('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', () => {
      dropdown.classList.remove('open');
      btn.classList.remove('open');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    });
  })();

  /* ── Mobile Nav ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const btn  = $('#navHamburger');
    const menu = $('#navMobile');

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = menu.classList.toggle('open');
      btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', () => {
        menu.classList.remove('open');
        btn.classList.remove('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
    });
  })();

  /* ── Cookie Banner ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const banner   = $('#cookie-banner');
    const accept   = $('#cookieAccept');
    const decline  = $('#cookieDecline');
    const settings = $('#cookieSettingsBtn');

    function dismiss() {
      banner.classList.add('hidden');
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('cookieAcknowledged','1'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    if (sessionStorage.getItem('cookieAcknowledged')) {
      banner.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    accept.addEventListener('click',  dismiss);
    decline.addEventListener('click', dismiss);
    settings.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      banner.classList.toggle('hidden');
    });
  })();

  /* ── Scroll-aware nav ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  (function() {
    const nav = $('#main-nav');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      nav.style.background = window.scrollY > 20
        ? 'rgba(10,10,10,0.95)'
        : 'rgba(10,10,10,0.85)';
    }, {passive:true});
  })();
</script>
